mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMAIL_VERIFICATIONS ( EMAIL, AUTH_KEY, AUTH_TYPE, PAYLOAD, EXPIRED_AT, IS_VERIFIED, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{authKey}, 'SIGNUP', #{payload}, LOCALTIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '30' MINUTE, 'N', LOCALTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT AUTH_ID, EMAIL, AUTH_KEY, AUTH_TYPE, PAYLOAD, EXPIRED_AT, IS_VERIFIED, CREATED_AT, CASE WHEN LOCALTIMESTAMP > EXPIRED_AT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IS_EXPIRED FROM EMAIL_VERIFICATIONS WHERE AUTH_KEY = #{authKey} AND AUTH_TYPE = 'SIGNUP'
mapper.update: UPDATE EMAIL_VERIFICATIONS SET IS_VERIFIED = 'Y' WHERE AUTH_KEY = #{authKey}
